sections.title: First Quest
sections.note: Link starts with 3 hearts: 8 bosses and 5 overworld containers make 16. Level 9 has none. Screens are given as column A–P (west to east) and row 1–8 (north to south); the start is H8.

items.name: Southern coast cave
items.area: Southern coast, four screens east of the start (L8)
items.howTo: Bomb the rock wall left of the path north for a cave. A "Take any one you want" cave: the Old Man offers the Heart Container or a Red Water of Life. Take the potion and the container is gone for good.

items.name: Lake Hylia bush cave
items.area: Lake Hylia shore, one screen south of Level 1 (H5)
items.howTo: Burn the fifth bush from the right with a Candle. A "Take any one you want" cave: the Old Man offers the Heart Container or a Red Water of Life. Take the potion and the container is gone for good.

items.name: Boulder cave north of Level 2
items.howTo: Bomb the lower right of the big rock for a cave. A "Take any one you want" cave: the Old Man offers the Heart Container or a Red Water of Life. Take the potion and the container is gone for good.

items.name: Northeast raft cave
items.howTo: Sail the Raft north from the dock (P4) to the cave. A "Take any one you want" cave: the Old Man offers the Heart Container or a Red Water of Life. Take the potion and the container is gone for good.

items.name: East coast dock
items.howTo: Lying on the sea by the coast: cross the gap with the Stepladder to reach it.

sections.title: Second Quest
sections.note: Again 3 to 16. Three Old Men (one in Level 4, two in Level 7) take 50 Rupees, or a Heart Container if you won't pay.

items.name: Graveyard cave
items.howTo: Push the gravestone for stairs, coming through the Lost Woods. A "Take any one you want" cave: the Old Man offers the Heart Container or a Red Water of Life. Take the potion and the container is gone for good.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon says it needs the Power Bracelet; StrategyWiki just has Link push the stone.

items.name: Desert cave
items.howTo: Play the Recorder to reveal the stairs. A "Take any one you want" cave: the Old Man offers the Heart Container or a Red Water of Life. Take the potion and the container is gone for good.

items.name: Death Mountain cave
items.howTo: Play the Recorder to reveal the stairs. A "Take any one you want" cave: the Old Man offers the Heart Container or a Red Water of Life. Take the potion and the container is gone for good.
items.notes: StrategyWiki puts it one screen east of Spectacle Rock (G1); Zelda Dungeon's directions lead to I1.

items.name: Northeast raft cave
items.howTo: Sail the Raft north from the dock (P4) to the cave, as in the First Quest. A "Take any one you want" cave: the Old Man offers the Heart Container or a Red Water of Life. Take the potion and the container is gone for good.

items.name: East coast dock
items.howTo: As in the First Quest: cross the gap with the Stepladder to reach it.
